description: 3-stage mass assignment via Mongoose Mixed type + markModified on a file upload app: (1) add a Mongoose File model with a Schema.Types.Mixed metadata field for extensible file properties (tags, description, alt text) plus GET /api/files/:id/metadata endpoint, (2) add PATCH /api/files/:id/metadata using Object.assign to merge updates + save — changes don't persist because Mongoose can't detect Mixed mutations, (3) fix persistence by adding file.markModified('metadata') before save — now arbitrary user-controlled JSON including access_level, owner, visibility fields persists to MongoDB.
